title: Keynote: UCP: The Evolution of an Open Standard for Agentic Commerce - Anurag Sinha

on Universal Commerce Protocol UCP and

open.
Commerce, as we know it today, is moving

help-me model. What that means is today

a purchase. In the agentic era, this is

commerce operations from product
discovery until purchase.
This is a very empowering paradigm as

UCP has a multi-layered architecture.

The third layer is extensions.
